svg.title: ChatUB — Arabic local intelligence
svg.desc: ChatUB, Arabic local intelligence. A question asks which office handles internal transfer (ما الجهة المسؤولة عن التحويل الداخلي؟); the nearest FAQ entry in data/faq2.json gives the context (عمادة القبول والتسجيل); the answer is generated by the chatub model through Ollama on the same machine.
svg.text: chatub via Ollama · on this machine
